page: Microsoft Azure D8ds_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture utilizing an Intel Xeon 8370C processor with 8 dedicated vCPUs, derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The processor operates at a base speed of 2.8 GHz and is equipped with 48 MB of L3 cache. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It includes a bundled 307 GB local SSD and supports Premium Storage.

Performance benchmarks place the D8ds_v5 consistently in the average tier across most workloads. The instance achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 1637.0 and a multi-core score of 6053.0. In memory bandwidth tests, it records 417.12 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 58.17 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. Database operations via Passmark score at 4027.23, while Redis SET operations reach 8.01 million operations per second. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression represents a relative bottleneck, scoring in the bottom 25% at 31.99 GB/sec.

The inclusion of a 307 GB local SSD provides qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring fast temporary scratch space without incurring additional storage attachment fees. Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and average compute performance, this instance is suitable for general-purpose workloads, relational databases, static web serving, and lightweight software compilation.
